name: AVA.exe alpha demo
author: Guardian_exe
description:
“AVA.exe” is a Metroidvania-style game where you play as AVA on her journey to escape the only world she’s ever known. Will you choose to uncover the secrets of the Labyrinth, or remain blissfully unaware? The way you play determines the story you find!

Please excuse the rough edges: this is an unfinished hobby project. If you’re interested in updates or discussions about “AVA.exe,” check out the Twitter development page (https://twitter.com/InternalUtopia) and the Discord server (https://discord.gg/S6gEcdCjEy).
